versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.

music-generation-studio 0.1.7

- Tightened workflow: genre, structure, and vocal/instrumental route must be confirmed before music generation.
- Default "surprise me" song generation removed; explicit creative intent is now required.
- Route covers, gift songs, and short BGM requests to specialized skills instead of this package.
- Clarified pre-generation steps: always label song structure/sections in lyrics before submission; BPM/key/tempo numbers no longer go into style captions.
- Updated guidance on iteration: after review, only extend or regenerate the strongest section, never the full song automatically.
- Removed redundant documentation and deprecated skill-card.md.
Publish the reviewed Music Generation Studio workflow with its English ClawHub listing.
